channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Youth summit launches 381-day campaign honoring Rosa Parks’ legacy
item.description: A new generation of civil rights advocates will convene in Montgomery near where Rosa Parks was arrested 70 years ago to strengthen their communities.

item.title: Governor Ivey lights Alabama Capitol Christmas tree Friday
item.description: The 38-foot Alabama Capitol Christmas tree, decorated with 40,000 lights, will be illuminated Friday under the theme “Every Light a Prayer for Peace.”

item.title: Founder of national accounting firm to offer TROY’s commencement keynote
item.description: William H. “Bill” Carr, namesake of the School of Accountancy, built his Alabama-born firm into one of the nation's fastest-growing advisory firms.

item.title: Alabama Trucking, lawmakers join fight against illegal operators to boost safety
item.description: Alabama Trucking joined a national coalition, outlining a seven-point action plan focused on technology and enforcement to eliminate dangerous safety loopholes.

item.title: Alabama Securities Commission changes rule, allows advisers to publish client testimonials
item.description: The policy shift leveled the playing field for more than 100 state-registered advisers who previously could not compete with larger firms.

item.title: Bloomberg backs HBCU-charter schools in Alabama with $20 million investment
item.description: A Forbes report details Bloomberg’s $20 million effort to grow HBCU-based charter schools beginning with Stillman College and Tuskegee University.

item.title: Free speech, media rights groups decry University of Alabama magazine closures
item.description: Advocates demanded reinstatement after the university cited a nonbinding memo to shut down publications focused on Black culture and women’s lifestyle.

item.title: Bill would let Alabama voters decide whether to abolish the death penalty
item.description: Rep. Chris England prefiled the bill on Tuesday. The 2026 Legislative Session begins January 13.

item.title: Alabama prisoners planning new work strike in 2026
item.description: With scrutiny of Alabama prisons at a high point, prisoners are planning a new work strike to demand change.

item.title: Opinion | Andrew Sneed is the candidate Alabama voters claim they want
item.description: Democrat Andrew Sneed is connecting with voters in the way they say they want with policies they like. But will partisan politics matter more?
